Name: Lumisteria More Produces
Author: Lumisteria
Description:
Based on my old mod when you were able to make dandelion jelly, here is the fresh, new version for 1.6.
Features :
- Make jelly from dandelion, and edible flowers (either with the tag or an edibility value high enough)
- Make wine from dandelion
- Make pickles from eggs
- Make dried beans, garlic, modded spices, modded herbs, modded beans, flowers
- Configure if the new items (dried veggies, pickled eggs, and dried flowers) count toward perfection
- Configure each kind of product individually (dandelion, eggs, edible flowers, garlic, green bean, modded beans, spice, herb, flower), to enable/disable them.
Consider using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28261]Machine Control Panel[/url]﻿ for finer tuning.

Some produces have chances to give more than one jar/packet/bottle based on various criterias (foraging skill, number of eggs picked, farming skill, depending of the product)

Downloads.Description: Adds several products, some as new items, some as variation of existing ones. More jelly flavours, yum!
